title: Money & currency
body:
Japan runs on cash more than its high-tech reputation suggests, especially at yatai and small local shops — plan to carry yen rather than assume cards work everywhere. Seven Bank ATMs (28,000+ nationwide, inside every 7-Eleven) accept foreign-issued Visa, Mastercard, Amex, JCB, Discover and Diners Club cards 24/7, with an English-language screen — the reliable cash source for the whole trip.

Tax-free shopping is still on the instant point-of-sale exemption system for this trip: show your passport at a tax-free-registered store and the 10% consumption tax comes off at checkout. Japan switches to a refund-at-departure model on Nov 1, 2026 — after these dates — so it doesn't affect this itinerary. ⚠ The minimum per-store purchase threshold (commonly cited elsewhere as ¥5,000) isn't confirmed against an official source — ask at the register.
